about: Cairo prayer times as published by Egyptian newspapers that attribute them to the Egyptian General Authority of Survey. This is a SECONDARY source: the authority's own timetable could not be reached on 2026-10-09 (egsa.gov.eg is the Egyptian Space Agency, a different body). Times are local clock times, 24-hour. Replace with the primary timetable when the owner supplies it.

Al-Watan, 'مواقيت الصلاة اليوم الأربعاء 1 إبريل 2026' (says: as announced by the authority on its official website)
